secrets.name: FRED_API_KEY
secrets.description: Federal Reserve Economic Data API key — required for /api/fred-data (macro indicators). Get it free at https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/api_key.html

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic/Claude API key — optional, enables AI-generated bias/sentiment/dossier text. Without it, functions fall back to static text. Get it at https://console.anthropic.com

secrets.name: FMP_API_KEY
secrets.description: Financial Modeling Prep API key — optional, used for treasury yield series in /api/dxy-correlation. Get it at https://site.financialmodelingprep.com/developer/docs

secrets.name: FINNHUB_KEY
secrets.description: Finnhub API key — optional, adds Finnhub news alongside RSS feeds. Get it at https://finnhub.io
